senses.gloss: (cmp. טִין) to be moistened and softened, (of grains) to be easily pealed in grinding.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 3:4">Makhsh. III, 4</cite> <he>וטָנְנוּ</he> and the wheat grew prepared for grinding. [Tanḥ. Vayiggash 9 <he>טננתה</he> some ed., read <he>טִגַּ׳</he>.]

senses.gloss: to prepare for grinding. Makhsh. l. c. המְטַנֵּן בחול if one prepares wheat by mixing with sand; ib. 5 המט׳ בטיט וכ׳ with dried clay.—Part. pass. מְטוּנָּן, f. מְטוּנֶּנֶת.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 6b">M. Kat. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>שדה מ׳</he> moist and fat soil, opp. <he>גריד</he>.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="I00576">same</cite>. Makhsh. l. c. <he>מְטִינִּים בחול</he> (or <he>מֵטִינִ׳</he> fr. <cite ref="I00388"><he>טין</he></cite>). Ib. 5 <he>לְהָטֵן</he> Mish. ed. (Talm. ed. <he>להָטֵל</he> fr. <cite ref="I00508"><he>טָלַל</he></cite>). Tosef. ib. II, 2 <he>להטיח</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>להָטֵין</he>).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 5:16">Tosef. Shebi. V, 16</cite> (twice) <he>להטיל</he> (Var. <he>להטין</he>), (once) <he>להטין</he>; Y. ib. VII, beg., 37ᵇ <he>מהו לחטן בחוטין</he> (read: <he>להָטֵן בו חטין</he>); ib. (repeatedly) <he>לחטן</he> (corr. acc.).
